statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring study) was billed
Diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
